dom.title: Storage | One | Fast synchronous key-value storage on iOS, Android, and web

paragraphs.outerHTML: One.Storage is the app’s key-value store: string keys, string values, every call synchronous, with the same verbs as the web’s localStorage. Use it for app state, caches, and settings. Use SecureStore for secrets and Database for structured or large data.
paragraphs.text: One.Storage is the app’s key-value store: string keys, string values, every call synchronous, with the same verbs as the web’s localStorage. Use it for app state, caches, and settings. Use SecureStore for secrets and Database for structured or large data.

paragraphs.outerHTML: On iOS and Android a shared C++ engine serves calls over JSI. A process-local map indexes values in a memory-mapped log in the app’s private storage. Writes append records; when the log fills, it compacts live entries if enough space is unused, or grows the mapping. Compaction writes a snapshot and renames it over the old log. The store belongs to one process; app extensions do not share it.

paragraphs.outerHTML: This is ordinary persistent app storage. It provides no encryption or explicit flush API, and a completed write is not a guarantee against device power loss.

dom.title: Pager | One | Swipe between React Native pages on iOS, Android, and web

paragraphs.outerHTML: One.UI.Pager fills its viewport with one direct child view per page. iOS uses a paging UIScrollView, Android uses ViewPager2, and web uses CSS scroll snap. Give the pager a size, and keep a stable key on each page.
paragraphs.text:
One.UI.Pager fills its viewport with one direct child view per page.
iOS uses a paging UIScrollView, Android uses ViewPager2, and web uses
CSS scroll snap. Give the pager a size, and keep a stable key on each page.

paragraphs.outerHTML: onPageScroll delivers { position, offset } throughout a drag or animated settle. A completed settle delivers the landing page with offset: 0. Use this event as the single writer of continuous progress; onPageSelected reports the selected page, and onPageScrollStateChanged reports { pageScrollState }, one of idle, dragging, and settling.
paragraphs.text:
onPageScroll delivers { position, offset } throughout a drag or animated
settle. A completed settle delivers the landing page with offset: 0.
Use this event as the single writer of continuous progress;
onPageSelected reports the selected page, and
onPageScrollStateChanged reports { pageScrollState }, one of idle,
dragging, and settling.

paragraphs.outerHTML: setPage(index) animates to a page; setPageWithoutAnimation(index) moves immediately. setScrollEnabled(enabled) changes whether user swipes are enabled. The page commands take a nonnegative integer index. An index beyond the mounted pages does nothing. Removing the selected last page selects the last remaining page. A resize preserves the selected page. Invalid prop values and invalid index types throw synchronously on all platforms.

dom.title: Pager | One | Swipe between React Native pages on iOS, Android, and web

paragraphs.outerHTML: One.UI.Pager fills its viewport with one direct child view per page. iOS uses a paging UIScrollView, Android uses ViewPager2, and web uses CSS scroll snap. Give the pager a size, and keep a stable key on each page.
paragraphs.text:
One.UI.Pager fills its viewport with one direct child view per page.
iOS uses a paging UIScrollView, Android uses ViewPager2, and web uses
CSS scroll snap. Give the pager a size, and keep a stable key on each page.

paragraphs.outerHTML: onPageScroll delivers { position, offset } throughout a drag or animated settle. A completed settle delivers the landing page with offset: 0. Use this event as the single writer of continuous progress; onPageSelected reports the selected page, and onPageScrollStateChanged reports { pageScrollState }, one of idle, dragging, and settling.
paragraphs.text:
onPageScroll delivers { position, offset } throughout a drag or animated
settle. A completed settle delivers the landing page with offset: 0.
Use this event as the single writer of continuous progress;
onPageSelected reports the selected page, and
onPageScrollStateChanged reports { pageScrollState }, one of idle,
dragging, and settling.

paragraphs.outerHTML: setPage(index) animates to a page; setPageWithoutAnimation(index) moves immediately. setScrollEnabled(enabled) changes whether user swipes are enabled. The page commands take a nonnegative integer index. An index beyond the mounted pages does nothing. Removing the selected last page selects the last remaining page. A resize preserves the selected page. Invalid prop values and invalid index types throw synchronously on all platforms.
